results.title: Sherman's March Through the Carolinas
results.overview: Follows General William T. Sherman's 1865 Union push from Savannah, Georgia, into South Carolina. The film details the campaign's battlefield clashes at Broxton and River's Bridge, a rare Union cavalry defeat at Aiken, and the continued Union advance toward Columbia and North Carolina.

results.original_title: Shaka Ponk - The Final Fucked Up Tour
results.overview: The grand final before extinction of the group exclusively on cinema! Pour leur tournée d'adieu, The final fucked up Tour, Shaka Ponk a investi tous les Zéniths et festivals de France durant presque 2 ans: plus de 60 dates à guichets femés, 1.5 million de fans déchainés, des shows de pure énergie , Punk et Rock n'Roll with the group in a secret. Leur tout dernier show filmé à l'Accor Arena a été immortalisé and will be diffused in the cinema for a unique soirée. A last chance to assemble to (re)live this historic concert...sur grand écran!

results.title: (Love Song)
results.overview: An unfinished love song connects two people in Tokyo and Bangkok. Sota is an overly serious researcher who was suddenly ordered to work in Tokyo. One day he returns from Tokyo to Bangkok and reunites with Kai whom he had feelings for when they were students. Kai is active as a photographer and also pursuing music when they reunite. This makes Sota a bit nervous. Kai, however, is surprised that Sota recalls the 'unfinished song' he once sang for him. The duo slowly grow closer once again, but each have a secret as to why they can't complete the song. Yet this unfinished song connecting the two of them begins to resonate with both once again!

results.title: Fairyland
results.overview: A father-daughter relationship evolves through an era of bohemian decadence in 1970s San Francisco to the sober and heartbreaking era of the AIDS crisis in the 1980s.

results.title: An Enemy Within
results.overview: On his wedding night, Caleb Wingate is ordered to kill his father-in-law before midnight or his bride dies. As a deadly assassin closes in and family secrets erupt, Caleb must uncover the truth before the night ends in blood.

results.title: Aabeer Gulaal
results.overview: Two wounded souls, brought together by chance, find solace in each other's company and gradually develop a profound connection that blossoms into love.

results.title: Blueberries
results.overview: Sara is on holiday in a beautiful palace belonging to her lover’s relatives, but the summer bliss quickly turns into a nightmare. Trapped in a web of family lies and manipulations, she faces a moral dilemma. Who can be trusted when the line between loyalty and betrayal begins to blur?

results.title: Britain and the Blitz
results.overview: Documentary looking back at a Britain during the darkest days of WWII using stunning new archived footage and interviews with people who lived through it.

results.title: Blind Hunt
results.overview: Trang, a real estate agent who was raped, fears her boyfriend Hiệp will leave her, so she lures him to a homestay to propose. There, she is horrified to meet Long—the owner—who looks exactly like her attacker. Adding to the mystery, Long’s wife, Ngọc, also turns out to be one of the man’s victims. As Trang secretly investigates the truth, the situation grows increasingly tangled, revealing a dark conspiracy awaiting them all.

results.title: Await
results.overview: A pregnant woman makes a series of phone calls to her doctor and loved ones while she waits alone to give birth at her parent's bathtub.

results.title: Remains
results.overview: Three refugees try to escape from a dystopian UK after climate catastrophe.

results.title: Shutter
results.overview: After a senior analog photographer discovers the spectral image of a former college student haunting his photos and coming to life, his girlfriend investigates the phantom, uncovering a horrific past crime that is now claiming his friends' lives one by one.

results.title: The Pursuit of Lust 4
results.overview: Money talks in this sensual drama, where a company director’s apparent generosity towards his top employee and his alluring girlfriend hides a darker motive. When the diligent worker is sent on a business trip, the lustful boss makes his move on his hot partner.

results.title: The Husband
results.overview: Setareh is a widow whose husband has died in an accident after marrying his second wife. Now if she wants to give birth to her own child, she has to seek a husband desperately. In her path of life, she confronts different women victims in the society – a victim of acid attack, a victim of domestic violence, a victim of oldness and loneliness, a victim of limitations for women musicians and bitter memories of the victims of prejudice against women footballers…

results.title: Pro.vision
results.overview: Oleg, who is deafblind and trapped in a dungeon of blindness, longs for sensations and impressions. And fate gives him, seemingly helpless, a chance to live a week to the fullest - during these seven days he will get lost in a megalopolis, fall into the clutches of criminals and escape from them, make a journey and, of course, meet love.
